params.body:
Third step for this measurement, after abovebeyond-ai/elixir#172 and #268. The hourly round of 18:00 UTC wrote verdicts on every measured row, so the PHP rule next to each line goes.

- A line takes the word Elixir gave its facet (`owner`, `gateway`); a facet Elixir did not judge (an old row) is `background`, never `ok`.
- The wording "expires in N days" versus "valid until" follows the threshold that fired (`OWNER_TOKEN_VALID`), not a number on the screen.
- Numbers left in the card: none. The per-key rows keep mapping Elixir's state word to a level.

Tests: the fixtures carry the verdicts Elixir writes for each case; one case pins background-not-ok. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean.
params.title: The Credentials card holds no number of its own
